title: Lakeside Boats & Boards
specs: Year round operation with warm dry-suits available in winter and spring
Toronto's premier choice for night paddling with illuminated kayaks and SUPs
Accessible with mega-board and tandem vessels for clients with mobility impairments
Caregiver rental is always FREE for clients with mobility impairments
Kids groups must be 10 years old or over unless special arrangements are made
Recommended weight below 180 lbs for transparent tandem kayak
Private instructor available for $45/hr, strongly suggested for kids and large groups
Events include lessons, team-building, races, excursions, and themed parties
Family reunions, corporate events, birthday and bachelorette parties supported
